summary.zh: 接入 IMAP/SMTP 邮箱，读信、找信、起草回复
summary.en: Read, search, and draft replies in your IMAP/SMTP mailbox

description.zh:
用授权码或应用专用密码接入 QQ、163、126、腾讯企业邮、阿里云邮箱、Gmail、iCloud、Fastmail、Yahoo、Zoho 与自定义 IMAP/SMTP 邮箱。
插件提供邮件列表、会话阅读、写信、账户管理与新邮件通知，并让 Agent 搜索、阅读、归档邮件和起草回复；发送前由你确认。
description.en:
Connect QQ, 163, 126, Tencent Exmail, Alibaba Mail, Gmail, iCloud, Fastmail, Yahoo, Zoho or any custom IMAP/SMTP mailbox with an authorization code or app password.
The plugin provides a message list, conversation reading, composing, account management and new mail notifications, and lets the agent search, read, archive and draft replies; you confirm before anything is sent.
